title: BootstrapRenewed
description: The payload of identity.bootstrap_renewed/v1, renewal of an expired, unconsumed bootstrap (docs/design/m0/14 R8). The system actor replaces the bootstrap secret: the event carries the new secret's hash (never the secret), when it was made and its expiry, 24 h later. The projection keeps only the latest, so the previous secret no longer verifies. Valid only before the first operator exists; the event's subject is the system actor. It is also the payload of identity.bootstrap_issued/v1, the first secret, which the first start records once (14 R4).

hash.description: argon2id over the secret, of the token hash format (records/token.json).
